_comment: Second prospective stage-gated re-prompt trial for XR-1: stall-gated re-prompting (docs/stage_gate_state_signal_analysis_20261103.md). Run with GATE_CONFIG pointing here and GATE_RUN_PREFIX=xr1_stage_gate_trial2.
_design_source: Trial 1 (docs/stage_gated_reprompt_results_20261030.md): re-prompting ArrangeTea at mug-stage entry harmed 18 baseline successes and rescued 9 failures; every harmed seed's baseline mug stage took 446-703 steps, i.e. was on the normal path. BreadSelection's jam re-prompt at entry helped 29 / harmed 4.
_delay_source: 617 = 90th percentile of the steps from mug-stage entry to mug placement in the 47 baseline successes of trial 1 (frozen before any trial-2 rollout). BreadSelection jam: 0 (re-prompt at entry), because its successful jam stages are long (median 877, 90th percentile 1,396 steps) and waiting would leave no time.
_primary_source: Primary: stall_gated_reprompt minus baseline on ArrangeTea, two-sided exact McNemar, alpha 0.05. Secondary: the same on BreadSelection (replication of trial 1), macro over both, and gated_reprompt minus stall_gated_reprompt.
_seeds_per_task_source: 200, before any trial-2 rollout: the projected ArrangeTea effect is about +0.04 to +0.09 (stall gate rescuing ~5-9% of all seeds, harming ~1-2%); exact McNemar power at n=200 is 0.85 for 7%/1% and 0.60 for 7%/2%.
_base_seed_source: 410007-410206: unused by every previous XR-1 run (trial 1: 400007-400106, smoke 499007; ladder 300007-340007 ranges).
_features_source: XR-1 SAFE token at inferences inside whitelisted stages (every 4th inference of the stage and the first after each switch), for an offline SAFE-based gate.
